title: Crossed Wires
story: The relay room receives all three branches, and Hal can repair the machine only if the signal is rebuilt without a lookalike replacing any output. Three circuits ask for a number sequence, an expression and a corrected typo, with the Caps, Tab and modifier-first Space exceptions along the way, then a final mixed recall checks every mapped output. The machine lights in sequence and Hal pulls down a false panel to reveal the Night Shift elevator stop.

steps.objective: Walk north through the hub gallery to the relay room door.
Talk to Hal about the relay review.
Relay card desk A: type the number sequence (cobalt circuit), moving the cursor under the held layer.
Relay card desk B: type the expression (orange circuit) after the Shift-first Space cards.
Relay card desk C: correct the typo (mint circuit) after the Tab focus lane.
Run the final mixed recall on the relay console.
Walk back to the machine and look at the false panel Hal pulled down.

dialogue.speaker: hal

dialogue.speaker: hal

dialogue.speaker: hal

dialogue.speaker: engineer

dialogue.speaker: engineer

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Glyph Dispatch: carry expressions across every circuit and repair one typo at the relay. The first clean run is a baseline, nothing more.

then.text: Systems seal earned. The machine's false panel hides the Night Shift elevator stop.
Night Shift elevator stop revealed behind the false panel.

state_changes.before: The routing machine is in its before state with its panel closed, the three relay conduit families are dark, the relay lamp is off and Mira waits at the chute.
state_changes.after: The routing machine is in its after state: nodes, core, beacon and ports lit, a service walkway open and the false panel hanging open on the Night Shift stop. The relay conduits are lit, hub lamps pulse and Mira has moved to the relay room.

visible_changes.note: nodes, core, beacon, ports, stubs lit; service walkway opens; false panel drops open on the Night Shift stop
three conduit families light in sequence in the relay room
Hal pulls the false panel down (`hal_false_panel_pull_n`, one-shot, holds the last frame); on frame 2 the machine's `routing_panel_closed` part swaps for `routing_panel_open`
Mira moves from the chute to the relay room and is pleased
